caveats.description: L Train reduced service was in effect during data collection for this report; tunnel work completed April 27, 2020.
Construction activity occupied lanes on 6th Ave (14th–15th) and 14th Street (Irving Place to 3rd Avenue) during the monitoring period.
Data collection was suspended after Winter 2020 due to COVID-19; future quarterly reports paused until travel conditions normalize.
Weekend street closures on 11th Street (6th–7th Ave) and 15th Street (Union Square E to Irving Place) on January 18, 19, 25, 26.

Some riders complained that removal of bus stops at 14th Street & Fifth Avenue and on the Lower East Side is detrimental to disabled and elderly customers; MTA notes additional walking distances are generally short and not more than two blocks.
For some parallel streets, October 2018 data was not available and May 2019 was used for pre-implementation data instead.
Pre-implementation PM peak travel times for 13th and 17th Streets were adjusted in the re-issued Fall 2019 Report to correct a calculation error.
Vehicle volume changes do not directly indicate congestion changes, as roadway operations are influenced by signal timing, pedestrian crossings, lane designations, and driver behavior.
Bicycle volume comparisons are not possible in this report because winter pre-implementation data is unavailable. Seasonal factors like weather strongly affect bike ridership.

Some turning movements at Union Square East/4th Avenue (westbound) were prohibited at the time of pre-implementation data collection (June 2015), so large percentage increases at that location reflect a change from a prohibited (near-zero) baseline.
